mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition allows audit entries with invalid role-operation pairs to exist, which LeastPrivilege must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidPermission { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.user.role = Doctor and ae.access_type = ListAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing care-team gating allows clinical users to succeed (Permitted outcome) without active care-team membership, directly violating the predicate.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareteamRequired { some ae: AuditEntry, u: User, p: Patient | ae.user = u and ae.patient = p and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.access_type = RecordRead and (no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = u and ctm.patient = p and ctm.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the uniqueness constraint on note IDs allows duplicate note_id values, violating the append-only and immutability invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateNotes { some disj n1, n2: ClinicalNote | n1.note_id = n2.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing audit ID uniqueness allows duplicate audit_id values, violating immutability of audit entries.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.audit_id = ae2.audit_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the requirement that every note has a matching audit entry allows orphaned notes without audit records.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanedNote { some n: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.access_type = AddNote and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.note_id = n.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the requirement that denied clinical access use NotCareTeamMember basis allows leakage of PatientNotFound vs. denied distinction.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageOnDenial { some ae: AuditEntry | let clinicalRoles = Doctor + Nurse + Pharmacist + ClinicalAdmin | ae.user.role in clinicalRoles and ae.access_type = RecordRead and ae.outcome = Denied and ae.authorisation_basis = PatientNotFound }
